summary: Premier Personnel Group is a family-owned boutique staffing and recruiting firm at 10 Woodbridge Center Drive in Woodbridge, NJ, placing temporary, temp-to-hire and direct-hire workers across seven central New Jersey counties. Its site lists 15 open client requisitions (mostly full-time light-industrial/maintenance and office-support roles) handled by a three-person recruiting team, with intake through phone, a long web application form, or in-person visits. Founded in 1986 and marking a 40th anniversary in 2026, the firm runs a single office on weekday hours of 8:30am–4:00pm.

facts.fact: Premier Personnel Group is a local, family-owned boutique staffing agency in Woodbridge, NJ serving Middlesex, Union, Somerset, Mercer, Monmouth, Essex and Hunterdon counties.
The site's structured data lists a founding date of 1986-01-01, and a '40th Anniversary' badge appears site-wide.

Services are temporary staffing, temp-to-hire and direct/permanent hire; industries covered include clerical, accounting, call center, data entry, medical billing/coding, industrial/manufacturing, warehouse, HR and technology.

The Find A Job page lists 15 open client requisitions, including machinist, maintenance mechanic, press set-up, facilities technician, operations admin, customer service, parts administrator and inside sales roles, in towns such as South Plainfield, Edison, Mountainside, Old Bridge, Dayton, Elizabeth and Parsippany.
Office address is 10 Woodbridge Center Drive, Suite 640, Woodbridge, NJ 07095; main phone 732-750-5600.
Hours are Monday–Friday 8:30am–4:00pm, closed weekends; the contact page asks visitors to complete a form or call to set up an appointment.

Candidate intake is an online employment application (education, three prior employers, software skill ratings, references, resume upload) or an in-person visit, followed by a recruiter interview, I-9 verification, optional safety training and online skills assessments.
The firm participates in E-Verify for all temporary and temp-to-hire candidates and offers additional background screening at client request; clients may also let PPG interview on their behalf.
The company's directory listing states it is a 'Small (11-50)' staffing agency specializing in general staffing and administrative/clerical, offering temporary, permanent and temp-to-hire placements.

The Meet the Team page lists three recruiting staff: Kathy (Senior Recruiter, joined 2005), Aimee (Senior Recruiter, recruiting since January 2018) and Lance (Recruiter, joined full-time 2019), each with a direct dial and email.
The Birdeye business profile shows a 3.7 average from 14 reviews and states the profile has not been claimed by the business owner.
The site's footer credits American Creative as the website provider and links Facebook, Twitter and LinkedIn profiles.

operations_signals: Customer and candidate intake is phone-first (732-750-5600) or a single contact form that explicitly asks users to 'set-up an appointment'; no online booking or self-scheduling exists (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/contact-us/).

Office hours end at 4:00pm on weekdays and the office is closed weekends, so any inquiry after 4pm waits until the next business day; no after-hours line, chat or auto-response is published (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/contact-us/).

Candidate applications are captured through a long single-page web form (personal details, education, three employment history blocks, software proficiency ratings, three references, resume upload) or completed in person at the office (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/application/).

Every candidate is interviewed by a recruiter in the office, then goes through I-9 verification, optional safety training and online skills assessments before placement (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/faqs/).

Client onboarding involves a site visit and a detailed company profile; the FAQ notes many clients skip interviewing and 'just leave it up to us' to select candidates (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/faqs/).

Job reqs are published one-by-one as individual WordPress pages; 15 were live and the newest two were updated in early November 2026 (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/find-a-job/ and https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/jobs-sitemap.xml).

Service area spans seven central NJ counties from a single Woodbridge office, so client and worksite coverage depends on recruiter travel and phone coordination (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/).

Recruiters publish individual direct dials and personal @premierpersonnelgroup.com emails, and reviews repeatedly describe contact by phone, text or email (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/meet-the-team/).
hiring_signals: No careers, 'join our team' or internal-jobs page exists in the site navigation or page sitemap; the only openings published are client requisitions (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/page-sitemap.xml).

The recruiting bench is three people (two Senior Recruiters and one Recruiter) covering a live board of 15 requisitions, implying each recruiter coordinates roughly five concurrent reqs plus candidate flow (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/meet-the-team/ and https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/find-a-job/).

Recruiter tenure is long and stable (2005, 2018 and 2019 start dates), with no visible recent recruiting hires on the team page, which suggests growth is being absorbed by existing staff rather than new headcount (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/meet-the-team/).

The open requisition mix skews to high-turnover, screening-heavy roles — maintenance mechanic, machinist, press set-up, facilities tech, operations admin, customer service, parts administrator — which generate repeated intake and scheduling work (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/find-a-job/).

No internal postings on Indeed, LinkedIn Jobs or ZipRecruiter could be retrieved (all blocked or rate-limited during research), so the absence of hiring ads is not conclusive (https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Premier-Personnel-Group,-Inc./reviews).
review_themes: On-site testimonials (about 19) consistently praise named recruiters for fast, responsive communication by phone, text and email, and for quick interview turnaround (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/reviews/).

Several reviewers credit the agency with temp-to-perm conversions and long-term placements, and one describes a decade-plus intermittent relationship with the firm (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/reviews/).
The in-office experience is described positively — being greeted, interviewed and matched to a role in one visit (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/reviews/).

A Yelp reviewer complained that a role advertised as permanent was in fact a lower-paid temp-to-perm position, a job-description accuracy complaint surfaced in the search result snippet (https://www.yelp.com/biz/premier-personnel-group-wood-ste-640bridge).

Aggregate third-party rating is mixed relative to the site's testimonials: Birdeye shows 3.7 from 14 reviews, and that profile is unclaimed (https://reviews.birdeye.com/premier-personnel-group-inc-149920224176033).

Employee-side reviews exist on Indeed (12) and Glassdoor (8), but both sites blocked access, so their themes could not be summarized (https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/Premier-Personnel-Group-Reviews-E404659.htm).
tech_footprint: Website runs WordPress with the All in One SEO 5.0.5 plugin and a custom theme, credited in the footer to American Creative (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/ and https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/meet-the-team/).

Forms are built with Contact Form 7 and Gravity Forms, protected by Google reCAPTCHA; there is no candidate portal or login area (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/application/ and page source at https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/).
Contact page embeds Google Maps for directions but offers no online scheduling, appointment booking or quote calculator (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/contact-us/).
No live chat, chatbot, SMS widget or click-to-text feature is present anywhere on the site (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/).
No applicant tracking system or job-board integration is visible; requisitions are plain WordPress pages linked from a single Find A Job list (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/find-a-job/).
The Articles/News page exists in navigation but carries negligible content, indicating little publishing or content marketing (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/blog-news/).

Social presence is limited to footer links to Facebook, Twitter and LinkedIn; the firm also appears in third-party directories (Birdeye, staffingdirectory.net, chamberofcommerce.com) (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/meet-the-team/ and https://reviews.birdeye.com/premier-personnel-group-inc-149920224176033).
growth_signals: The firm is marking 40 years in business, with a 40th Anniversary badge placed in the header and hero slider across the site (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/).

Requisition activity is current: job pages were updated 23 October and 2 November 2026, and the jobs sitemap was regenerated 2 November 2026, indicating an actively managed client book (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/jobs-sitemap.xml).

The team page was last updated in September 2026 and now includes individual recruiter bios and direct contact details, a recent refresh of marketing assets (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/team-sitemap.xml).
Recruiter headcount expanded historically (Aimee in 2018, Lance in 2019) but no additions appear after that on the team page (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/meet-the-team/).
No new office locations, awards, press coverage or expansion announcements were found in public sources during this research (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/contact-us/).
decision_maker: Unknown — no owner, president or GM is named on the company website; the site profiles Kathy Partelow as Senior Recruiter, Lance Partelow as Recruiter and Aimee Malave as Senior Recruiter (https://www.premierpersonnelgroup.com/meet-the-team/).

inferences.inference: Resume screening and candidate matching are likely a manual bottleneck handled by only three recruiters.
inferences.reasoning: The Find A Job board carries 15 concurrent client requisitions with frequent updates, applications arrive as unstructured web-form submissions with free-text employment history, and no ATS or parsing tool is visible on the site.

inferences.inference: Inquiries that arrive after 4:00pm or on weekends probably go unanswered until the next business day.
inferences.reasoning: Published hours are 8:30am–4:00pm Monday–Friday with weekends closed, and there is no chat widget, auto-responder, booking link or after-hours message described on the contact page.

inferences.inference: A meaningful share of administrative work is re-keying applicant data from forms and emails.
inferences.reasoning: Candidates apply through a long web form or in person, then recruiters interview and verify I-9 details; no integration between the website forms and any tracking system is evident from the site's markup.

inferences.inference: Compliance and onboarding steps (E-Verify, I-9, safety training, skills assessments, optional background checks) are repeated per placement and are strong candidates for automated checklists.
inferences.reasoning: The FAQ describes these steps as standard for every temporary and temp-to-hire candidate, and the client mix is high-volume light-industrial and clerical work.

inferences.inference: Reputation management is an underused lever: third-party ratings lag the curated testimonials on the company site.
inferences.reasoning: The website displays about 19 glowing testimonials while the Birdeye profile shows 3.7 from 14 reviews and is unclaimed, so review requests and responses are likely ad hoc.

inferences.inference: Client knowledge and placement history are concentrated in long-tenured recruiters, creating continuity risk and an opportunity to codify it.
inferences.reasoning: Three recruiters have start dates of 2005, 2018 and 2019, and client onboarding relies on in-person site visits and personalized company profiles rather than a documented system.

inferences.inference: The 'family-owned' description plus the shared Partelow surname among two recruiters suggests family leadership, but no ownership title is published.
inferences.reasoning: The homepage calls the firm family-owned and family-operated, and the team page lists Kathy Partelow and Lance Partelow in recruiting roles; no owner or principal title appears anywhere on the site.

data_gaps: LinkedIn company page was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge, so the ~14% year-over-year headcount growth noted by the mapper could not be verified.
Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, Yelp and BBB pages returned 403/verification walls; employee-review themes and any BBB complaint history could not be read directly.
Google Business Profile rating and review count could not be retrieved; the only third-party aggregate captured was Birdeye (3.7 from 14 reviews).
No internal job postings for the firm's own staff were found, so current hiring activity for recruiters or coordinators is unknown.
Revenue, exact employee count (directory says 11-50) and client concentration are not disclosed publicly.
No owner/GM name or title is published, so the economic buyer for a consulting engagement is unidentified.
The Articles/News page returned almost no extractable content, so no company announcements or awards could be reviewed.
One negative Yelp review was characterized only from a search-result snippet because the Yelp page itself was blocked.
